index_groups.description: Symmetric, index-time. If any member matches a record (whole word / phrase), the others are appended to its expanded view before embedding. May be empty.

query_expansions.description: Directional, query-time, embedding-only. Maps colloquial query vocabulary onto the corpus's canonical term.

when.description: Colloquial trigger words / phrases (matched whole word / phrase). Any casing; normalized to lowercase at load.

add.description: Canonical term appended for embedding. One term by design; any casing, normalized to lowercase at load.

items.description: One directional query rule: when any `when` trigger matches the query, the single canonical `add` term is appended to the embedded query string only (never the lexical-overlap bag — keeps short queries from being swamped).

title: Synonyms
description: Generic zsh/English synonym data. Two disjoint mechanisms — see synonyms.yaml for the contract.
